summary: Specimen-level aggregation, nesting, denominators, BH correction, and the committed per-specimen CSV/JSON/XLSX values are technically consistent. Acceptance is blocked because the primary between-sample report generator performs and presents inferential tests even with one specimen per group, contradicting the claim's explicit non-inference scope and the safer legacy comparison behavior. The committed pilot also lacks the expected between_sample_analysis package, so its primary PDF, workbook, PowerPoint, plots, and source tables cannot be cross-validated.

findings.title: Primary biological report generator permits pseudoinference from one specimen per group
findings.impact: Generating the advertised primary between-sample package for the committed pilot would calculate and present bootstrap intervals, permutation p-values, Mann-Whitney p-values, Welch p-values, effect sizes, and FDR q-values from n=1 per group. This can misleadingly convert two specimen descriptions into a genotype comparison and conflicts with the claim's explicit non-claim.
evidence: scripts/generate_v57_biological_comparison.py:192-250 has no minimum-n guard before inferential calculations.
scripts/generate_v57_biological_comparison.py:298-305 applies multiplicity correction to those results.
scripts/generate_v57_biological_comparison.py:1289-1297 directs readers to use permutation-test FDR q-values as the primary comparison.
scratch/v571_remediation_final2_pilot/specimen_group_comparison_qc.json records KJ n=1 and WT n=1.
By contrast, sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:12621-12628 and 12677-12704 suppress inferential estimates below three specimens per group.
findings.recommendation: Apply the same minimum-specimen guard to generate_v57_biological_comparison.py, emit an explicit insufficient_specimens status, leave intervals/p-values/q-values unavailable below the threshold, and add n=1 and n=2 adversarial tests covering CSV, PDF, Excel, and PowerPoint output.

findings.title: Expected primary cross-format reporting package is missing from acceptance evidence
findings.impact: The required PDF/spreadsheet/plot/source agreement cannot be established for the advertised primary biological report. Only legacy study outputs and per-specimen reports are committed, leaving the new report path unvalidated on the production replay.
evidence: USER_GUIDE.md:697-701 describes between_sample_analysis/01_biological_results and 02_quality_control as the primary report packages.
sperm_segmentation_saturnv5.7.1.py:13447-13497 invokes and validates generation of those package directories.
Read-only Get-ChildItem inspection found no scratch/v571_remediation_final2_pilot/between_sample_analysis directory.
V5_7_1_VALIDATION_REPORT.md:83-86 cites only the two per-specimen batch PDFs, not the primary between-sample PDF, workbook, presentation, plots, or source tables.
findings.recommendation: After correcting the small-n behavior, generate and retain the complete between_sample_analysis package from the committed pilot or a replicated study, then add automated cell/plot/PDF reconciliation against the exact specimen source tables.

limitations: Focused pytest execution was unavailable because the active Python environment has no pytest module; cited tests were inspected but not executed.
No full image stack was run, as required.
The pilot contains one specimen per group and therefore cannot validate real between-specimen uncertainty or biological inference.
PDF text extraction dependencies were unavailable; committed page images and XLSX XML were inspected directly instead.
recommended_follow_up: Add and run small-n report tests proving all inferential fields remain unavailable for one or two specimens per group.
Regenerate the complete primary biological/QC reporting package and reconcile every displayed value with specimen_summary.csv and derived statistical tables.
Retain the current specimen-level unit, metric-specific n, BH correction, and separation of biological morphology from exploratory count/QC outcomes.
